title: ResourceEndpoint Definition v1

TechnologyKind.description: TechnologyKind that owns protocol/build semantics for this endpoint.

ResourceKind.description: Resource kind addressed by this endpoint.

Visibility.description: Public/private resource namespace of the endpoint.

Id.description: Stable endpoint identifier used by selection and PublicationDestinations.

CredentialProfile.description: Optional credential-profile identifier; secret values are never stored here.

Enabled.description: Whether the endpoint participates in effective selection.

Stability.description: Release/snapshot stability where required by the ResourceKind.

description: Defines one external resource endpoint before inheritance/default resolution. The generated data object preserves declared values; the effective Builder model applies semantic rules separately.
